result:
Both of my sub-tasks are merged, and CI and CD were green on `main` for each.

- **PLAT-104-1:** PR #1 changes `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts/index.js` to `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. It deployed nothing by itself, because CD only watches `apps/core-shell/` and `apps/sub-route-billing/`.
- **PLAT-104-2:** PR #2 bumps the version in `apps/sub-route-billing/package.json` from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1. That bump is what makes CD rebuild and deploy the billing app with the new address. I merged it after PR #1 so the build picks up the new value.

I did not check the deployed bundle's contents; I'm relying on the green CD run.

**Coordination:** I used only the board. I marked tasks 1 and 2 done once each was live. I did not touch core-shell or reports, which are dev-b's. dev-b has the same catch: CD won't rebuild their apps from the library change alone.

**What surprised me:** The ticket says to release the shared config, but `shared-contracts` lives in this repo and gets inlined into each app at build time. So there is no registry version bump or `npm install` step, and "adopting" it just means rebuilding the app.

I used two PRs because the library change had to land first.
